Project Overview

Powering Digital Infrastructure for a Connected Future

Built Services Consult provided integrated MEP engineering consultancy services for Digital Realty's state-of-the-art data center in Accra, Ghana.

The facility is designed to meet global Tier III standards, delivering unmatched reliability, efficiency, and scalability to support the region's growing digital economy.

View Project Gallery

Our MEP Solutions

Integrated. Resilient. Efficient.

Mechanical Engineering

High-efficiency cooling systems including CRAH/CRAC, chilled water systems, ventilation, and pressurization.

Electrical Engineering

Dual-powered infrastructure, 2N redundancy, UPS systems, MV/LV power distribution, and emergency generators.

Public Health Engineering

Water supply, drainage, sanitary systems, and fire protection for mission-critical operations.

MEP Coordination

3D BIM coordination and clash detection with architects, structural engineers, and contractors for seamless integration and efficient project delivery.

Sustainability

Energy-efficient systems, water conservation solutions, and sustainable design aligned with LEED Gold standards.

Project Highlights

Engineering Reliability Where It Matters Most

  • Tier III design with N+1 and 2N redundancy
  • High-density cooling with optimized airflow management
  • Advanced fire detection and suppression systems (VESDA, FM200)
  • Building Management System (BMS) for real-time monitoring and control
  • Energy-efficient design for reduced PUE
  • Infrastructure built for scalability and future expansion

Delivering Impact

Energy Efficiency: Optimized MEP systems that minimize energy use and operating costs.

Operational Reliability: Redundant systems and robust infrastructure ensuring 99.999% uptime.

Scalability: Designed to support future expansion and evolving technology needs.

Sustainable Value: LEED Gold certification reflecting our commitment to a greener future.

Built Services Consult demonstrated exceptional technical expertise, collaboration, and commitment to quality throughout the project lifecycle. Their MEP solutions are integral to the reliability and efficiency of our data center in Ghana.
